messages:
harper (billing): Heads-up: Card on file for NovaBiome (acct_6610) declined repeatedly during renewal charge. They asked to pay by international wire in EUR to avoid interruption. Can we expedite wire instructions + conditional waiver of late fee?

payments-bot: payment_attempt_failed: 5 attempts (2026-05-04T08:02:11Z, 08:07:23Z, 08:25:04Z, 09:01:55Z, 09:15:03Z) -> decline_reason: issuer_declined; processor_msg: processing_error

omar (acct-mgr): Invoice INV-2026-499 for €42,300 (EUR) due 2026-05-05. Their AP says SEPA is not available from their bank, so they need an outgoing wire in EUR via correspondent bank. They want written bank block right away.

harper (billing): Bank block for reply (paste to email):
```
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Bank (EUR settlement): Banque Centrale Européenne - Paris Branch
IBAN: FR76 3000 6000 0112 3456 7890 189
BIC/SWIFT: BCEPFRPPXXX
Correspondent (USD intermediary if needed): First Capital Bank / SWIFT: FCBUS33
Reference: INV-2026-499 / NovaBiome (acct_6610)
Please attach MT103 or bank receipt and send to billing-intl@redwood.ai.
```
Notes: advise customer to include invoice ref exactly or funds may be delayed.

nina (treasury): Quick checklist: 1) Require MT103 and beneficiary name match. 2) If an intermediary bank is used, treasury must confirm FX path and fees. 3) We can accept EUR or USD; if USD, we will post the converted net amount and record FX fees.

carla (finance): On waiving fees: we can waive a single late fee (up to €100 equivalent) if (a) proof of wire is received within 24 hours AND (b) funds clear within 5 business days. For large enterprise renewals we can escalate to waive fully but need compliance sign-off due to cross-border AML review.

kyra (compliance): Confirming: require originator bank name to match KYC. If origin country != customer country, need an AP contact verification call or two additional docs (bank statement + signed remittance form). If they provide MT103 with matching originator info, we can fast-track.

omar (acct-mgr): I called their AP; they'll route via a Luxembourg correspondent and said they'll send MT103. They asked whether Redwood would cover intermediary charges.

nina (treasury): We do not cover intermediary bank fees as standard. However, for renewals we can absorb up to €150 in intermediary fees on a case-by-case. If they ask, tell them Redwood will credit up to €150 upon receipt of proof of intermediary fees (MT103 showing charges). Any excess will be deducted from the invoice amount and we will reconcile afterwards.

carla (finance): After payment posts: set payment method to 'wire-intl', run usage reconciliation, and if there's an FX delta of >€50, open a short reconciliation ticket to AR.

harper (billing): Email template used: "Please initiate the wire with the details below and reply with the MT103. Include INV-2026-499 in the payment reference. Once we confirm funds and treasury posts them, we'll remove service holds and apply any agreed credits for intermediary fees. If you need a waiver, confirm MT103 within 24h."

omar (acct-mgr): Email sent. Marking INV-2026-499 as 'awaiting international wire'. Tagging treasury and compliance for monitoring. :envelope_with_arrow:
